; Adapted from jdkruzr/reTaskable commit 90fa23d2bb3ffad1f89dc045bc2c983174124667.
; Intake only: import in Nextcloud Calendar Settings; no headless sync.
; nextcloudCalendar — "Send to nextcloudCalendar" capture hook for the handwriting lasso menu.
; xochitl 3.27 (reMarkable Paper Pro, 5.6.75 chiappa). xovi + qmldiff extension.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
;
; Adds a button to the handwriting selection menu (SceneSelectionHandler's ?#tools:
; cut / copy / convert-to-text / delete) that captures the lassoed strokes as a
; CalDAV to-do WITHOUT altering the note. On tap it clones the selected items, runs
; cloud handwriting recognition (the same MyScript path "Convert to text" uses), and
; shows a confirm/edit dialog. On the dialog's Create it writes an intake JSON that
; Nextcloud Calendar imports into a reviewable task draft. The note is never altered;
; accidental pen touches cannot dismiss the deliberate modal.
;
; Four coordinated patches, mirroring how the stock convert-to-text flow is wired:
;   A  SceneSelectionHandler.qml — the menu button + a `sendToNextcloudCalendar` signal
;   B  DeviceSceneView.qml       — bubble a capture request up; run convert-on-clone
;                                  when DocumentView says we're online
;   C  HwcSelection.qml          — recognize (no insert); emit text + ok/fail up
;   D  DocumentView.qml          — connectivity gate; the confirm/edit dialog; write
;                                  intake on Create
;
; The dialog AND the connectivity gate live in DocumentView: it is the only scope with
; the live PopupOverlay (id _popupOverlay) + the pen-input manager, and the only one
; where LinkProvider/Authentication are in scope (DeviceSceneView's stock convert path
; gates via the convertSelection signal handled up here). So Block B bubbles a bare
; nextcloudCalendarCapture() up; DocumentView decides offline (→ empty type-fallback dialog)
; vs online (→ clone+recognize, result back via nextcloudCalendarRecognized(text, ok)). The
; page anchor is read locally in DocumentView (root.document.id / root.currentPage).
;
; Published HASHED for xochitl 3.27 (qmldiff hashtab tokens, not symbol names). To
; read or edit: `qmldiff hash-diffs <device-hashtab> nextcloud-calendarSend.qmd -r` unhashes
; it in place; edit the readable form, then re-hash (same command without -r) before
; committing. The device hashtab is at
; /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/hashtab. See docs/m14-tooling/.

; --- A: handwriting-menu button + signal -------------------------------------
AFFECT [[3197972396468700595]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[10742505294233322867]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[197082485]]
		INSERT { signal sendToNextcloudCalendar }
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[214642769434]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[425121728314878811.16765000136167945189.7081261925573]]#[[3012293087768835154]]
		INSERT {
			~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
				~&5972374&~: sendToNextcloudCalendarButton
				~&481641799955318521&~: ~&5971598&~.~&233696851602406&~
				~&6504337259&~: ~&214642769434&~.~&6504337259&~
				~&8399601734642709923&~: ~&"16588797428236211658&~
				~&254542236275632405&~: ~&10742505294233322867&~.sendToNextcloudCalendar()
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- B: non-destructive convert-on-clone; relay the recognition result up -----
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			signal nextcloudCalendarRecognized(~&7083178290016&~ ~&6504315758&~, ~&6503679477&~ ~&5972579&~)
			signal nextcloudCalendarCapture()
			/* The online clone+recognize path, invoked by DocumentView only once its*/
			/* connectivity/login gate passes. Wrapping in convertSelection (the stock*/
			/* gate + language setup) is safe here because we only reach it online.*/
			function nextcloudCalendarConvertOnline() {
				~&6504254477&~.~&7282468819357443632&~(function () {
					~&11077763042784530127&~.sendToNextcloudCalendarFrom(~&8399340108982949229&~.~&5308518110917893541&~(~&8399340108982949229&~.~&15752433948179392809&~, ~&6504254477&~.~&15777890623490054006&~));
					~&6504254477&~.~&12148339614529610933&~();
				});
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[18399528329672988301]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			onSendToNextcloudCalendar: ~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarCapture()
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[11077763042784530127]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			onNextcloudCalendarRecognized: ~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarRecognized(~&6504315758&~, ~&5972579&~)
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- C: recognize (no insert); emit text + ok/fail up ------------------------
AFFECT [[15977735761668523171]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[233724020120234]]
		INSERT {
			signal nextcloudCalendarRecognized(~&7083178290016&~ ~&6504315758&~, ~&6503679477&~ ~&5972579&~)
			property ~&6503679477&~ sendingToNextcloudCalendar: ~&214625660372&~

			~&214604601930&~ {
				~&5972374&~: nextcloudCalendarTimeout
				~&7713147298280334&~: 25000
				~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
				~&495358363329399331&~: {
					~&5972376&~ (sendingToNextcloudCalendar) {
						sendingToNextcloudCalendar = ~&214625660372&~;
						~&8398536573969953217&~.~&15568081865960980320&~();
						~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarRecognized("", ~&214625660372&~);
					}
				}
			}

			function sendToNextcloudCalendarFrom(~&214629893131&~) {
				/* Reached only after DocumentView's gate confirmed online + logged in,*/
				/* so just recognize. The timeout guards a hung/slow server; a*/
				/* recognition Error routes to the type-fallback in onFinishedChanged.*/
				sendingToNextcloudCalendar = ~&6504329801&~;
				~&8398536573969953217&~.~&15319355904852707254&~(~&214629893131&~, ~&7712198086779994&~.~&5671208228825160146&~);
				nextcloudCalendarTimeout.~&233743006639214&~();
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[742117811095419965]]
		REBUILD [[12940955005542131354]]
			LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
			INSERT {
				~&5972376&~ (sendingToNextcloudCalendar) {
					~&5972376&~ (!~&7713012755563699&~) { ~&7083121450889&~; }
					nextcloudCalendarTimeout.~&6504295855&~();
					sendingToNextcloudCalendar = ~&214625660372&~;
					/* `failed` is HwcNotificationBar's error flag; guard in case it*/
					/* isn't in scope. Empty recognized text also counts as a miss, so*/
					/* a silent failure still routes to the type-fallback.*/
					~&197102514&~ rtFailed = ~&214625660372&~;
					try { rtFailed = ~&7082646676942&~; } catch (rtFErr) { rtFailed = ~&214625660372&~; }
					~&197102514&~ rtText = rtFailed ? "" : ~&3875029581909304837&~.plainText.replace(/\n/g, ~&"180905&~).~&6504329413&~();
					~&197102514&~ rtOk = !rtFailed && rtText.~&7082886407723&~ > 0;
					~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarRecognized(rtText, rtOk);
					~&7083121450889&~;
				}
			}
		END REBUILD
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- D: confirm/edit dialog; write intake on Create ----------
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[254547437090201330]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			/* The capture gate. LinkProvider/Authentication are in scope here (stock*/
			/* onConvertSelection uses them) but NOT down in DeviceSceneView — which is*/
			/* why the decision lives in DocumentView. Offline / not-signed-in skips*/
			/* recognition entirely and opens the empty type-fallback; otherwise the*/
			/* online clone+recognize runs and its result returns via*/
			/* onNextcloudCalendarRecognized. Mirrors the stock convert gate exactly so the*/
			/* connectivity semantics match (no surprise "requires Wi-Fi" toast).*/
			onNextcloudCalendarCapture: {
				~&5972376&~ (!~&9210209219278626665&~.~&7713275938201394&~ || ~&14571390169775532834&~.~&15652079942095156516&~ === ~&14571390169775532834&~.~&233697828699788&~) {
					~&254547437090201330&~.~&12148339614529610933&~();
					nextcloudCalendarDialog.openWith("", ~&214625660372&~);
				} ~&6503784146&~ {
					~&254547437090201330&~.nextcloudCalendarConvertOnline();
				}
			}
			onNextcloudCalendarRecognized: nextcloudCalendarDialog.openWith(~&6504315758&~, ~&5972579&~)
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[15549782143769420265]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			~&214600077661&~ {
				~&5972374&~: nextcloudCalendarDialog

				~&233739780873643&~: ~&14839296689095546654&~
				~&214646099849&~: ~&15549782143769420265&~.~&214646099849&~
				~&2122835675838176157&~: nextcloudCalendarColumn.~&2122835675838176157&~

				/* Deliberate modal: pen-on-canvas / tap-outside is a no-op (Ignore),*/
				/* and pen input can't reach the note behind it. Exit only via the*/
				/* explicit Create / Cancel in the HeaderInput. So an accidental*/
				/* pen-touch never loses or mangles the capture.*/
				~&17012884421348371483&~: ~&214600077661&~.~&8398624284572419691&~.~&7081519049453&~
				~&11412860438186802733&~: ~&6504329801&~

				property ~&6503679477&~ ~&5972579&~: ~&6504329801&~

				function openWith(~&6504315758&~, recognized) {
					~&5972579&~ = recognized;
					nextcloudCalendarInput.~&6504315758&~ = recognized ? ~&6504315758&~ : "";
					~&254547663425316670&~();
					nextcloudCalendarInput.~&214626153769&~ = ~&6504329801&~;
				}

				function writeIntake(~&233744916906391&~) {
					~&197102514&~ rtPage = ~&6504254477&~.~&477346483278306569&~;
					~&197102514&~ rtPayload = ~&6502785411&~.~&254548178208422824&~({
						~&233744916906391&~: ~&233744916906391&~,
						source_doc_uuid: ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~,
						source_page_key: "idx:" + rtPage,
						source_label: ((~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~ && ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~.~&505890565057603928&~) ? ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~.~&505890565057603928&~ : "reMarkable note") + " · p." + (rtPage + 1),
						captured_at: new ~&6502586279&~().toISOString()
					});
					~&197102514&~ rtReq = new XMLHttpRequest();

					rtReq.~&6504147419&~("PUT", "file:///home/root/.local/share/nextcloud-calendar/intake/cap_" + ~&6502586279&~.now() + ".json");
					rtReq.~&6504279475&~(rtPayload);
				}

				~&7081293658967&~ {
					~&5972374&~: nextcloudCalendarColumn
					~&214646099849&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&214646099849&~

					~&6503165774&~ {
						~&214646099849&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&214646099849&~
						~&233748328658231&~: !nextcloudCalendarDialog.~&5972579&~
						~&7713748390489352&~: ~&6503165774&~.~&7712381377343359&~
						~&6504315758&~: ~&6504222003&~("Handwriting recognition unavailable — type your task")
					}

					~&435226761427665314&~ {
						~&5972374&~: nextcloudCalendarInput
						~&214646099849&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&214646099849&~
						~&496814758264239564&~: ~&6504222003&~("Task text")
						~&15687297754887797348&~: ~&214625660372&~
						~&214626153769&~: ~&6504329801&~
						~&233748328658231&~: ~&6504329801&~
						~&477061882630366844&~: ~&6504222003&~(~&"7081296943613&~)
						~&8399893700003527327&~: (~&180989&~) => {
							~&5972376&~ (~&180989&~.~&6504329413&~().~&7082886407723&~ === 0) { ~&7083121450889&~; }
							nextcloudCalendarDialog.writeIntake(~&180989&~.~&6504329413&~());
							nextcloudCalendarDialog.~&254532220638374263&~();
						}
						~&8399894427373474444&~: {
							nextcloudCalendarDialog.~&254532220638374263&~();
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
